entries.name: GatewayMinter
entries.description: Entrypoint or minter of USDC on this chain for the Gateway protocol.

attestationSigners.description: Bridge validators, trusted to sign each minting payload on an incoming bridge tx.

entries.name: AleoDepositor
entries.description: Depositor account of one remote domain in the GatewayWallet. It holds the USDC balance that backs the domain's stablecoin and approves Gateway burn intents through ERC-1271 when exactly `signatureThreshold` of its attesters sign.

persistentSignatureBufferDelayBlocks.description: Blocks a disabled attester and a replaced signature threshold stay valid.

entries.name: GatewayWallet
entries.description: Exit point or burner of USDC on this chain for the Gateway protocol.

attestationSigners.description: Bridge validators, trusted to sign each burning payload on an outbound bridge tx.

entries.name: xReserve
entries.description: Entry point for USDC-backed stablecoins on remote blockchains. It forwards each deposit to the GatewayWallet, credited to one depositor contract per remote domain, and pays out attested withdrawals through the GatewayMinter.

aleoDepositor.description: Depositor contract that holds the GatewayWallet balance backing USDCx on Aleo (remote domain 10002).

aleoRemoteToken.description: Identifier of the Aleo token registered for USDC.
